name: Lean Business Services
note: Al-Ahli Gold Sponsor for 2026-27; its logo sits on the first team's jersey shoulder (sleeve). Tier proposed (serious) in the pull request; a maintainer sets it.

why.text: Lean Business Services, whose logo is on the shoulder of Al-Ahli's shirt, is wholly owned by Saudi Arabia's state fund, the Public Investment Fund. Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That's called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024.
